statement: Table 1 gives the degrees of St(k,n) for small k and n. For n at most 4: St(1,n) has degree 2; St(2,2), St(2,3), St(2,4) have degrees 4, 8, 8; St(3,3), St(3,4), St(4,4) have degrees 16, 40, 80.
